title: Independence of phi
description: Essential Criteria - The argument for f being independent of phi must be clearly stated and justified.

title: Independence of theta
description: Important Criteria - The reasoning for why f cannot be concluded to be independent of theta should be explained.

title: Energy limit case
description: Important Criteria - The explanation of the behavior of f as energy approaches zero must be provided.

title: Scattering cross section
description: Essential Criteria - The formula for the scattering cross section in terms of f must be correctly stated.

title: Born approximation formula
description: Essential Criteria - The formula for the first Born approximation for f must be provided with definitions of all quantities.

title: Validity conditions
description: Essential Criteria - The conditions under which the Born approximation is valid must be clearly stated.

title: Missing factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Common errors related to missing factors or constants in the formulas should be noted.

title: Sign mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria - Students should be cautious of sign mistakes in their calculations or final answers.
